messages:
maya_cs: Putting together a compact "Launchpad" one-pager for AMs/CSMs. Goal: simple, prescriptive steps for warmup (prefill), conservative batching, streaming fallback, plus 3 renewal-risk signals. Quick review pls.

owen_se: Love the name. Keep it lean: defaults, telemetry to watch, one paste-ready config + one warmup command. Make hosted defaults conservative.

sam_sre: Paste-ready hosted defaults (tiny):
```yaml
launchpad:
  prefill: true
  prefill_window_h: 24
  batch:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 10
    max_wait_ms: 120
  streaming:
    enabled: true
    min_stream_tokens: 6
  circuit_breaker:
    error_pct_threshold: 0.10
    cooldown_s: 300
```

rachel_csm: Handoff checklist (one-liner items for AMs): confirm model & quant, expected session RPM, 3 eval prompts + quality owner, renewal thresholds set, escalation contact.

maya_cs: Operator warmup (one-shot):
```bash
for p in "welcome" "digest" "reply"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"hosted-small","input":"'$p'","prefill":true}' &
done
wait
```

sam_sre: Day0-7 telemetry to surface: p95 latency, token/sec, cache hit rate (target >65% after warmup), median batch size, streaming fallback %.

rachel_csm: Renewal-risk signals to trigger AM outreach: DAU drop >20% in 7d; <50% expected sessions by day3; sustained p95 >800ms. Also auto-flag if support tickets spike >10% in 72h.

own_se: Troubleshooting cheats (one-liners): cache hit <40% -> verify prefix keys/prefill jobs; p95 >900ms -> reduce max_batch_size or lower max_wait_ms; error% >CB -> open CB and page oncall.

maya_cs: Add a short customer-facing paragraph: "During the warmup window (usually up to 48h) you may see slightly higher latency and token usage while caches populate. Your CSM/AM will monitor and adjust settings; if performance or adoption falls short we'll pause prefill and revert to conservative defaults while we investigate."

rachel_csm: Include a feedback form link in enablement emails: https://forms.redwood.example/launchpad-feedback -> critical responses tag renewal queue.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: create PR "launchpad-onepager" at 2024-05-10T17:00:00Z.

maya_cs: Thanks team 44b I'll assemble the PDF and push the PR, then ping AM rotation.
